title: helperScopes
responsibility: Identifies runtime helper references and their distinct named function callers without counting shadowed bindings.

inputs.name: helperScopes.node
inputs.description: The identifier or member-access syntax node, with its TypeScript parent chain intact.

inputs.name: helperScopes.name
inputs.description: The local binding name whose enclosing scopes should be checked for shadowing.

outputs.name: helperScopes
outputs.description: The enclosing named function path, or null at module level, and whether an inner binding hides this name.
